verdict.rationale: OpenRouter's own streaming API reference says it allows streaming responses from any model, so the UI can update as the model generates. Its schema is normalized across models and providers, so one streaming interface covers the whole gateway. missing for 10: documented token-by-token stream mechanics (e.g. SSE chunk format, mid-stream error handling, cancellation), explicit per-provider streaming parity, independent or hands-on corroboration of streaming.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream token-by-token responses through the gateway from any provider

citations.quote: The OpenRouter API allows streaming responses from any model. This is useful for building chat interfaces or other applications where the UI should update as the model generates the response.
OpenRouter normalizes the schema across models and providers so you only need to learn one.
